description: This file defines asynchronous service functions for managing products, including listing, getting, creating, updating, and deleting products using SQLAlchemy ORM models and an async database session.

methods.name: List[Product] list_products(db: AsyncSession, active_only: bool = True)
methods.description: Lists all products, optionally filtering for only active products, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Optional[Product] get_product(db: AsyncSession, product_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single product by its ID.

methods.name: Product create_product(db: AsyncSession, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new product record from provided data.

methods.name: Optional[Product] update_product(db: AsyncSession, product_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing product with given data and returns the updated entity.

methods.name: bool delete_product(db: AsyncSession, product_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID, returning True if successful.
